# Designer of the Year (DOTY)

> Designer of the Year is a competition held on the occasion of World Cotton
> Day Celebration, presented by the Fashion Design Council of Rajasthan
> (FDCR), for fashion, textile & design students from across Rajasthan,
> India.

## Key facts

- Event name: Designer of the Year (DOTY)
- Organizer: Fashion Design Council of Rajasthan (FDCR)
- Occasion: World Cotton Day Celebration
- Date: 7th October 2026
- Venue: Rajasthan Chamber of Commerce, Jaipur, Rajasthan, India
- Eligible participants: Fashion, Textile & Design students from across Rajasthan
- Categories: Fashion Design, Textile Design, Sustainable Design, Creative Innovation
- Awards: Cash prizes, trophies & certificates, featured showcase at the
  World Cotton Day Celebration, industry recognition & exposure, and
  internship & placement opportunities
- Presented in association with: Ministry of Skill Development and
  Entrepreneurship, Skill India, Skill Rajasthan, RSLDC, Amity University
  Rajasthan, Colours of Fusion, RCCI, Jaipur Utsav, and SEWA
- Registration: via the "Register Now" button on the official website,
  which links to a Google Form
- Official website: https://doty.co.in

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://doty.co.in): full event details, categories, awards,
  partners, and FAQ.
